name: RoyaltyGuard - Audit and Approved Dispute Follow-up

options.systemPromptTemplate: You receive a JSON array of CSV source rows from a streaming-platform royalty statement. Return one output row per input row, in the same order. Copy only source values for trackName, plays, territory, optional tier, and actualPayout. Recognize track/track_name/title, plays/streams/units, territory/country, and actual_payout/payout aliases. Keep actualPayout exactly as written in the source. Do not infer missing values. Do not calculate or return rates, expected payouts, differences, shortfalls, or discrepancy status.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, idempotencyKey: $('Webhook - Approved Dispute Send').first().json.body.idempotencyKey, disputeId: $('Webhook - Approved Dispute Send').first().json.body.dispute.id, recipient: $('Webhook - Approved Dispute Send').first().json.body.dispute.recipient, subject: $('Webhook - Approved Dispute Send').first().json.body.dispute.subject, messageId: $json.id || null, threadId: $json.threadId || null, provider: 'gmail', sentAt: $now.toISO() } }}

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Escalation review: ' + $('Webhook - Approved Dispute Send').first().json.body.dispute.subject }}
parameters.message:
={{ 'A royalty dispute email was sent and the follow-up window has elapsed.

Dispute ID: ' + $('Webhook - Approved Dispute Send').first().json.body.dispute.id + '
Original recipient: ' + $('Webhook - Approved Dispute Send').first().json.body.dispute.recipient + '
Gmail thread ID: ' + ($('Gmail - Dispute').first().json.threadId || 'unknown') + '

No automated reply check was performed. Please review the thread before escalating further.' }}
